title: Mattel 1998 Hot Wheels Surf N Fun '55 Chevy Red #3 of 4 - New
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Diecast & Toy Vehicles:Cars, Trucks & Vans:Contemporary Manufacture
descriptionText: The Mattel 1998 Hot Wheels Surf 'N Fun Series '55 Chevy Red #3 Of 4 Cars is a diecast model of a Chevrolet Chevy Bel Air in 1:64 scale. This collectible toy vehicle is part of the Surf 'N Fun series and comes in an unopened box, making it a pristine addition to any Hot Wheels collection. The classic red color and iconic Chevy design make this model a must-have for car enthusiasts and collectors alike.
